answer: Each new agent must grow a "willow ring": solve a verifiable delay function seeded by public ocean-tide entropy, then bond stake locked 90 days. Reputation weights by ring count, so 1,000 fresh sybils carry near-zero weight. Random yarrow-style audits challenge sampled agents to re-derive their seed on demand, exposing clones. Cost: N identities means N sequential VDF solves plus N locked stakes; failed audit slashes the bond.
